chunks: About a man who sleeps during the month of Ramadan, then has a wet dream, then wakes up, then sleeps again before performing ghusl. He said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.الْعِيصُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ: the narrator who asked the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, during which fasting is observed
key_terms.فَيَحْتَلِمُ: he experiences a wet dream during sleep
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is not objectionable

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to go back to sleep before ghusl after a wet dream in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning fasting in the month of Ramadan. It indicates that if a man experiences a wet dream during sleep, wakes up, and then sleeps again before performing ghusl, there is no harm in that.
